claim: In a distributed computing environment, a dedicated caching layer lets systems and applications run independently from the cache with their own lifecycles, and the cache serves as a central layer for disparate systems. This is especially relevant where application nodes can be dynamically scaled in and out: if the cache is resident on the same node as the application, scaling may affect the integrity of the cache.

evidence.quote: In a distributed computing environment, a dedicated caching layer enables systems and applications to run independently from the cache with their own lifecycles without the risk of affecting the cache.

The cache serves as a central layer that can be accessed from disparate systems with its own lifecycle and architectural topology. This is especially relevant in a system where application nodes can be dynamically scaled in and out. If the cache is resident on the same node as the application or systems utilizing it, scaling may affect the integrity of the cache.
